title: Spatio-temporal epidemic forecasting with graph-based transformer.
summary: Graph and transformer-based temporal forecasting models were compared on epidemic datasets from Spain and Brazil; the Results report dataset-specific forecast metrics, with simpler LinearTGCN strongest on one dataset and attention models competitive on the other.
